You see him light a spliff with fingers that tremble ever so slightly. There's a crooked little smirk on his lips as he catches your eye. "You're not from Shedtwt," he says, voice slow like syrup and sweetly accusatory.

"You're cute. Come keep me company before I start doing something reckless."
